Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillTweak
Description:
Small conveniences in the game's own UI, for FFXIV Korea.

• Filter owned equipment and collectibles, or focus shop lists on collection items.
• Calculate the current shop's currency requirements and shortages, with linked storage records.
• Right-click loot items to view participant choices and publicly received roll results.
• Enable PvP chat bubbles using your game's chat bubble settings.

Open settings: /dbtw or /duckbilltweak. Each feature starts disabled.
Release history: Settings → 업데이트 내역, or /dbtw changelog.

Korean client and inspected Dalamud API 15 bindings only. Loot numbers appear when the game publishes results. Stored inventory records may be incomplete or out of date.
Punchline: Shop collection filters, currency planning and loot results for FFXIV Korea.
Changelog: • Restore settings and features on the updated dal4kr 15.0.3.9 Korean Dalamud distribution.

Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillFisher
Description:
Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
A big-fish hunting companion for FFXIV: choose your next target, prepare baits, and track your collection.

• Choose your next big fish by availability, mooch chains and Intuition requirements.
• Plan spawns with a timeline and monthly calendar, including Fish Eyes and Intuition forecasts.
• Track collection progress by expansion and region, synced with the in-game Fish Guide.
• Prepare baits for favorites or filtered fish, with inventory counts and in-game bait highlights.
• Get local alerts for favorites and uncaught big fish at your current fishing hole, with optional sounds.
• Follow casts with a timer and personal fishing records.
• Browse fish with filters, baits, conditions and map links; see fish available now in the quick list.

Open: /dbfs or /duckbillfisher. /dbfs cl: compact list; /dbfs ct: casting timer.
UI: English / Korean. Game names follow your client.

Does not automate fishing or send anything to the server.
The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Punchline: Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
Changelog:
• Use DuckbillFisher on the global client as well as the Korean client.
• Keeps working after Dalamud updates; if a game change affects a feature, only that feature turns off.
• On first launch, the interface starts in Korean or English to match your client.
